name: cloak
_design_note: Single cloak template — material is the variation axis (cloth, wool, leather, silk, mithril, shadowweave, dragonscale, etc.). Light cloth gets +0 AC contribution; sturdier materials add via material bonus. Existing data has 17 cloak items — most of those are uniques or material variations of this template.
lore_template: A wide cloak of {material_name}, cut to fall to the heel and clasped at the throat. In cold stone passages it is warmth first and armor a distant second — and yet the wearers of good cloaks tend to outlive their bare-shouldered companions.
